summary: Single component ARCH-001 realises REQ-001..003 with a clear responsibility and location. The NFR/constraint approach (stdlib only) and the tie-breaking trade-off (max returns first maximal element) are credible. No interfaces or external data flows exist, so integration is not required.

checklist.item: Every requirement realised by a component

checklist.note: No interfaces; the public function signature longest_word(text) is given in the requirements
None declared; the only flow is str in, str or ValueError out through the public function
REQ-003 handled by str.split and built-in max
max(key=len) keeps the first among equal lengths, matching REQ-001
N/A with justification; unit tests cover behaviour

findings.description: The component is named 'longest' while the function is longest_word(text); the architecture does not state the function name or signature. Consider stating it in G3 design.

integration_applicability.reason: One component with no interfaces and no external system; it is a pure function using only the standard library.
